text:
Kevin: Heads-up — PR #8428 (kv-cache: tighten warmup fallback) needs dual signoff for tonight's RC5 window. CI is green but we want two reviewers on the rollback path before cut.
Marta: on it. I'll take a look in the next 20m.
Carol: can you @Sanjay for infra impact? it's touching the warmup logic we saw flake on yesterday.
Sanjay: pinged. I can check perf diffs and the canary smoke once Marta posts comments.
Marta: quick notes: small API change, added a fallback flag. left 2 inline comments about logging and a test flake.
Kevin: thanks. CI passed on linux/amd64 and macos, flaky test is unrelated from my local runs.
merge-bot: CI: All checks passed for PR #8428 — smoke-tests: green — deployable: yes
Carol: ack. if SLOs look okay on perf I'll give an approve. Marta, did you rerun the flaky test after your comment?
Marta: not yet — will rerun and post results in 10.
Sanjay: perf delta is +3ms p50, no tail regression on canary. canary logs look clean.
Danna: I'm on call for the window; I can act as second approver if others are tied up. @Kevin can you confirm rollback steps in PR description?
Kevin: added rollback steps and `gh` commands in the PR body: ```gh pr checkout 8428 && git revert -m 1 <merge-commit> && gh pr create --draft``` plus quick smoke checklist.
Marta: rerun done, flaky test passed second time.
Carol: reviewed the rollback steps, they look safe. approving now. :thumbsup:
Sanjay: approving — leaving a note about monitoring query rates post-deploy.
Kevin: great — that's two approvers. I'll merge at t+5m at the start of the RC5 window unless anyone yells.
Danna: noted; I'll be watching post-deploy dashboards and will run the smoke checklist.
merge-bot: Action: PR #8428 merged by Kevin at 1758203100 — deploy triggered to canary
Kevin: deploy triggered, thanks all. closing loop. :rocket:
